title: The tower is sold out and nobody lives there
description: Some of the most expensive apartments in the world are bought in order to stay empty. The lights stay off, the yearly tax on leaving them dark gets paid, and a tenant was never part of the plan.

scenes.narration: Half the windows in that tower have never been switched on.
scenes.imagePrompt: Night exterior of a very tall Dubai-style luxury residential tower, its glass and dark steel facade completely black and unlit from top to bottom except for a single small window glowing warm on a high floor, the tower's crown ringed in warm gold architectural light against the black glass below, the vast majority of the building in total darkness, brass and bronze window mullions catching a faint reflection, the shot framed to end above the street-level entrance so no canopy or signage is visible, wet asphalt in the foreground reflecting the scarce light, deep blue-black sky, no people

scenes.narration: The units are sold. In some new towers, one address in four is nobody's daily life.
scenes.imagePrompt: Night aerial of a cluster of luxury apartment towers with bronze-trimmed glass facades and brass rooftop cornices in a city skyline, the majority of apartment windows unlit, a scattering of warm lit units, dark river and dark streets far below, cold moonlight raking across the glass

scenes.narration: A twenty-million-dollar apartment is not shelter. It is money parked where a bank statement cannot follow.
scenes.imagePrompt: Vast empty living room of a high-floor luxury apartment styled like a seven-star hotel suite, a dark gold-leaf coffered ceiling filling the top third of the frame in shadow with a crystal chandelier glinting within it, floor-to-ceiling glass in gilt bronze frames overlooking a glittering Dubai-style night skyline, book-matched marble floor, a single silk-upholstered armchair under a white dust sheet, warm golden light pooling across the room, deep shadow in the corners

scenes.narration: Leaving it empty is not free. Taxes and charges run past a quarter million dollars a year.
scenes.imagePrompt: Underground parking level of a luxury apartment tower at night, rows of empty numbered parking bays framed in brushed steel, one car hidden under a fitted grey cover, spotless polished marble floor, a single row of overhead lights, deep shadow down the far end

scenes.narration: The owner might sleep there twelve nights out of the year.
scenes.imagePrompt: Opulent unused bedroom in a luxury apartment styled like a seven-star hotel suite, a carved gold-leaf headboard set against a dark upholstered wall filling the top third of the frame in shadow, a bed made with crisp white cotton sateen sheets pulled taut and tightly tucked with hospital corners, perfectly flat and smooth with no folds, draping or wrinkles anywhere, looking pristine and untouched as if never slept in, heavy velvet curtains held back with a gold tassel revealing a glittering Dubai-style night skyline, warm golden lamp light falling across the sheets, deep shadow

scenes.narration: Cities noticed. Several now tax a home left dark, a few percent of its value, every year.
scenes.imagePrompt: Close facade of a soaring Dubai-style luxury residential tower at dusk, tiers of glass panels trimmed in brushed bronze mullions between bands of pale marble spandrel panels, dramatic warm sunset reflections streaking across the dark glass, every window completely dark and unlit except for exactly one glowing warm window near the center, a golden architectural light strip tracing the tower's edge, minimal composition, no people

scenes.narration: The tax gets paid. A tenant was never the point, and would only complicate the exit.
scenes.imagePrompt: Wide view of a row of ornate brass mailboxes with fluted gold trim set into a gold-veined dark marble wall in the grand lobby of a Dubai-style luxury tower, a crystal wall sconce and a low vase of white orchids on a marble console beneath it, warm light glowing across the polished brass, a herringbone parquet floor reflecting the glow, deep shadow around the edges, no text, no people

scenes.narration: So the lights stay off. The building is sold out, and nobody is home.
scenes.imagePrompt: Night exterior of a soaring Dubai-style luxury residential tower with a bronze and marble-clad base, its glass windows completely black and unlit from top to bottom with only a slender gold architectural trim line tracing its vertical edges, a golden ring of light crowning its peak against a glittering Dubai skyline of lit towers behind it, seen from across still black water with the entire scene mirrored below, a warm lobby glow at street level, dramatic wide composition, no people
